verdict.rationale: Pulley docs show SAFE creation using standard YC templates, e-signature collection in-platform without third-party tools, convertible notes/SAFEs as first-class contract tabs on the cap table, and pro-forma modeling for SAFEs/priced rounds. This covers create, send, e-sign, and cap table modeling for SAFEs and convertible notes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end e-sign-to-cap-table flow and explicit confirmation that conversion terms auto-populate without manual entry.
